thesis: Operating merit is demonstrated, but both advocates concede the missing per-share cash and financing reconciliation. Neither the gain-distorted trailing multiple nor the operating margin establishes purchase value after AI investment and dilution. Neutral does not infer distress from note or equity proceeds.
strongest_counterexample: Revenue grew24%, operating income30% and operating margin improved from32% to34%, with Cloud growth82%; these improvements survive excluding the $98bn investment gain.
invalidation_conditions: A matched primary bridge shows recurring per-share earnings growth above zero after investment-gain normalisation and owner cash after AI investment/debt obligations above zero, resolving the central shareholder-return gap.
A subsequent comparable operating margin below the prior32% with revenue growth at or below zero would invalidate the retained operating-improvement premise.
evidence_gaps: Recurring owner cash and normalised per-share earnings.
Equity dilution and debt funding obligations.
Intrinsic valuation excluding investment marks and capacity-return economics.
decisive_factors: $98bn gain inflates EPS and apparent trailing valuation.
Senior-note proceeds $20.3bn and equity proceeds $49.6bn need shareholder reconciliation.
34% operating margin shows current company conversion, not owner cash after investment.
